source_type: Parent/student communication (email) announcing Semester 1 elective options and a ranking request
source_note: Transcribed from the pasted email. This is NOT a full course catalog like the high school one (docs/school/yorkville-catalog.json) — it lists exploratory electives and lunch clubs only, with brief descriptions and no credits or formal course structure. The source text was truncated in the clubs list ('...such as Prayer Team, Speech/Debate, eta'), so the club list is incomplete.

structure.selection: Students rank their top 3 choices; placement is not guaranteed. Students who do not list a top 3 are placed in an elective that may not be a preferred choice.
structure.purpose: Enhance the middle school experience and let students grow across a variety of options.

electives.name: Archeology
electives.description: Covers the basics of how to study a real piece of history, plus hands-on learning where students research historical artifacts brought into class.

electives.name: Agriculture
electives.description: Introductory course exposing students to the world of agriculture to prepare them for a possible Agriculture track in high school at Yorkville Christian.

electives.name: Art
electives.description: Builds skills through the understanding, appreciation, and creative processes of art.

electives.name: Physical Education
electives.description: A variety of team sports throughout the semester.
electives.requirements: PE shirt and gym shoes required.

electives.name: Robotics
electives.description: STEM class learning and understanding coding and robotics.

electives.name: Social Media and Me
electives.description: Learn how to be more human in a digital world through a Christ-centered lens.

electives.name: Spanish 1A
electives.description: Grade 7 students take the first half of High School Spanish 1.

electives.name: Spanish 1B
electives.description: Grade 8 students take the second half of High School Spanish 1. Students who pass the assessment may test into Spanish 2 as a freshman at YCS.
electives.pipeline_to: High School Spanish II (via placement test)

electives.name: Study Skills
electives.description: Required for all Grade 6 students in Semester 1. Learn the 'ins and outs' of beginning middle school.

lunch_clubs.note: List is incomplete in the source (truncated after Speech/Debate).
